item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Marilyn Monroe: Discography [FLAC or DSD]
item.description:
I'm looking for Marilyn Monroe's discography, which includes her contributions to movie soundtracks—something she did quite often as both an actress and an artist.

If anyone has digital copies of these or could create them and share them, I would be immensely grateful.

The format can be FLAC, DSD, or ISO.

Here is a list:

1. Gentlemen Prefer Blondes (1953)

https://www.discogs.com/master/2523...s-Recorded-Directly-From-The-Sound-Track-Of-T

2. River of no Return (1954)

https://www.discogs.com/master/821321-Marilyn-Monroe-River-Of-No-Return

3. There's No Business Like Show Business (1954-1955)

https://www.discogs.com/master/877851-Marilyn-Monroe-Theres-No-Business-Like-Show-Business

4. Some Like It Hot (1959)

https://www.discogs.com/master/481873-Various-Some-Like-It-Hot

5. Marylin (1962)

https://www.discogs.com/master/254917-Marilyn-Monroe-Marilyn

6. Heat Wave (1955)

https://www.discogs.com/master/1364715-Marilyn-Monroe-Heat-Wave

7. I Wanna Be Loved by You (1987)

https://www.discogs.com/master/1576574-Marilyn-Monroe-I-Wanna-Be-Loved-By-You

Thank you very much for your attention.
